messages:
kevin: Quick question — can we add a gateway-side header override so the gateway flips EU traffic to an eu-failover zone when backend latency > 120ms? Thinking we stamp an internal header rather than trusting client-sent values.

maria: We already have geo cookie + X-RW-Region header. Latency-based decision is new though — agree with gateway stamping. Need to decide probe cadence and safety checks.

natalie: Careful: if we flip zones mid-session KV cache miss rate will spike. Need grace period + cache warming or only apply for stateless endpoints.

sam: FWIW we could restrict automatic failover to stateless routes (generation, embeddings) and force an explicit fallback path for stateful flows. Also consider sticky session TTL in the cookie.

kevin: Implementation idea: gateway measures backend RTT, keeps a short sliding p95 (2s window). If p95 > threshold set X-RW-Preferred-Zone: failover and route to eu-failover pool. No client-trust.

maria: Also need telemetry: metric like rw.routing.failover_count with labels {route, region, zone}. Console should expose per-route failover rate + threshold config. Alert if > 1% sustained.

natalie: Agreed on telemetry. Also add a cooldown so we don't flip back/forth — e.g. once a route fails over, keep preference for 30s.

kevin: Pseudoconfig I'm thinking — quick YAML:
```
route:
  match: /v1/generate
  routing:
    policy: latency_based
    threshold_ms: 120
    probe:
      path: /__rtd/probe
      interval_ms: 1000
    cooldown_ms: 30000
    override_header: X-RW-Preferred-Zone
```

maria: Nice. For the probe use a lightweight probe path that exercises the same stack (not just TCP). Make sure it respects auth/quotas.

sam: We should also emit a discrete event on header rewrite so logs show original region + new zone. Helps debug.

natalie: Can we also gate this behind a per-route feature flag and a global env RW_LATENCY_FAILOVER=true? Start in staging.

kevin: I'll prototype the gateway change behind a flag. Who picks up console + metrics? @maria?

maria: I can own console + metrics. Will add dashboard tiles: failover rate, avg probe latency, cache-miss delta after failover.

routing-bot: routing-bot: canary deployment started for kevin/dynamic-latency-failover on staging-eu-1 at 2026-03-18T10:05Z

sam: :thumbsup: keep default OFF in prod. Also loop in eng-sre for rollout plan and runbook.

natalie: And add 24h retention for header-rewrite traces to help root cause if we hit elevated cache misses.

kevin: Plan: (1) prototype gateway probe+header flag (2) metrics + dashboard (3) 48h staging canary (4) prod gradual rollout 0.1% -> monitor. Will open PR and link RFC.

maria: Add a small eval to measure token-cost impact from extra cache misses during canary.

routing-bot: routing-bot: staging probe summary — p95 probe latency ~85ms, failover not triggered in initial run (no traffic spikes).
